jamal: quick security check — need to enable ephemeral streaming capture for a 1hr window to debug intermittent truncated responses from the /v1/stream endpoint. plan: write streaming chunks + request headers to an ephemeral s3 bucket with 24h lifecycle, encrypt at rest, and only grant a temporary read role to SRE. will redact Authorization and phone/email via regex. leaving short prompt prefix (first 200 chars) and hashing the remainder with sha256. want sign-off before we flip this on. sample config below: 

jamal: ```
capture: streaming
window: 1h
bucket: s3://redwood-ephemeral-debug-us-east-1
retention: 24h
redact_headers: [Authorization, Cookie]
redact_fields: [email, phone]
prompt_policy: keep_prefix(200) + sha256_rest
access: role:team/sre-debug-temporary
```

jamal: note — we will NOT log raw tokens or full prompts, only the truncated prefix + hashed remainder. asking: (1) is the redact/pseudonymize approach ok? (2) can we grant team/sre-debug-temporary read access for 2 hours? (3) any other blockers (audit, export)?

maria (security): short answer: close but a couple tweaks. please do NOT keep a 200-char prefix for any requests that might contain PII by default. instead: keep prefix only if it does NOT match PII regex; otherwise store prefix length=0 and keep metadata + hash. for user identifiers, pseudonymize with keyed HMAC (KMS-backed) rather than plain sha256 so we can revoke. redact Authorization and Cookie headers fully. add access logging + require justification in ticket before role is issued. please add a list of example log lines we expect to capture.

jamal: thanks — can do HMAC(KMS) for user_id. i'll change rule: keep_prefix(200) only if no PII detected, otherwise prefix="". example log lines: 

jamal: ```
{
  event: \"stream_chunk\",
  req_id: \"r-abc123\",
  user_hmac: \"hmac:xxxxx\",
  prompt_prefix: \"Customer: hi, can you...\",
  chunk: \"...partial text chunk...\",
  headers: {traceparent: \"00-...\", content-type: \"application/json\"}
}
```

alex (sre): ok from infra side if security ok. we need exact IAM role name and TTL. also require bucket-level audit logs enabled and an ACL that denies cross-account access. ping me the role ARN and we can create temporary creds scoped to list/get for 2h. :thumbsup:

security-bot: reference: https://go.redwood/sec-logs#ephemeral-capture — remember approval + ticket required for temp access.

maria (security): approve pending two changes: (1) switch to HMAC(KMS) for user ids, (2) update runbook to rotate the bucket lifecycle to 12h (we prefer shorter retention by default). if you update and comment here i will sign off.

jamal: updating config: set retention=12h, user_id=hmac(kms), prompt_prefix conditional on PII. will open ticket with justification + sample log lines and attach runbook. will post role ARN here once created. thanks for quick review. :pray:

alex (sre): great — once ticket is up @alex i'll schedule role creation.

jamal: done — ticket #INC-2026-314 attached, role requested: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/team-sre-debug-temporary. filing follow-ups in that ticket.

maria (security): approved. include an artifact in the ticket proving regexes used for email/phone redaction and a link to the KMS key policy.

jamal: will do. thanks everyone.
